title: AI Weekly
sub: Le {n} notizie più rilevanti sull'intelligenza artificiale {window}
topic: AI News: covering models, applications, regulation, business, and general developments

areas.what: Impact on business models, operations, strategy, investments, M&A, commercial partnerships, enterprise adoption, productivity, workforce; billion-dollar compute/services deals
areas.not_for: Technical details on chips or models, benchmarks, architectures, technical release notes (those are Frontiers)
examples: Copilot cuts quoting times for sales teams
Bank automates due diligence with LLMs
Billion-dollar compute deal between AI lab and cloud provider
Startup raises Series B to automate back-office work
areas.name: Business
areas.note: Impatto su modelli di business, strategia, investimenti, M&A, adozione in azienda e lavoro

areas.what: Scientific and engineering advances: models, training, evaluation, technical safety, peer-reviewed papers, open-source releases with technical value, new measurable capabilities
areas.not_for: Industry gossip, company rivalry, market share, who is winning the race, commercial battles (those are Business)
examples: New multimodal model with longer context
Training technique that improves reasoning
New benchmark for agent evaluation
Open-weight model matches proprietary results
areas.name: Frontiers
areas.note: Avanzamenti scientifici e ingegneristici: modelli, training, valutazione, sicurezza tecnica

areas.what: UX/UI, conversational interactions, multimodality, accessibility, tools for designers, new interaction metaphors, agent UX
areas.not_for: Policy and legal matters (Regulation) and pure research with no impact on the user experience (Frontiers)
examples: Figma introduces an AI co-designer
New multimodal gestures for assistants
No-code tool for AI-first apps
Voice interface redesigned for accessibility
areas.name: Design
areas.note: UX/UI, interazioni conversazionali, multimodalità, accessibilità e strumenti per designer

areas.what: AI Act, rules, enforcement, lawsuits, licensing, copyright, data protection, audits, governance, standards and guidelines
areas.not_for: Corporate policy or market competition not tied to rules (those are Business)
examples: EU approves AI Act implementing rules
FTC investigates competitive risks of AI deals
Court ruling on training data and copyright
State passes AI transparency law
areas.name: Regulation
areas.note: Norme, cause legali, copyright, protezione dei dati, governance e standard

areas.what: Experiments, creative or curious uses, demos, light applications that fit none of the other categories
areas.not_for: Serious business, research or regulation news
examples: Museum reimagines portraits with AI
Playlist generated from your dreams
AI episode of a classic TV series
Chatbot invents a new language for a game
areas.name: Just for fun
areas.note: Esperimenti, usi creativi o curiosi, demo e applicazioni leggere
